headerDisplay:
Kasa Python Plugin.

Most users do not require configuration and can just click "Save" to get started. See [README](https://github.com/ZeliardM/homebridge-kasa-python/blob/master/README.md) for more information.

enableCredentials.title: Enable Credentials
enableCredentials.description: Enable to use username and password for authentication.

username.title: Username
username.description: Username for the Kasa account. Required for cloud devices.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password for the Kasa account. Required for cloud devices.

enableEnergyMonitoring.title: Enable Energy Monitoring
enableEnergyMonitoring.description: Enable to add energy monitoring characteristics (Volts, Amperes, Watts, KiloWattHours) to supported devices.

powerThreshold.title: Outlet In Use Power Threshold (Watts)
powerThreshold.description: Power threshold used to mark OutletInUse as true on devices with energy reporting support. Values must be at least 0.001 and may use up to three decimal places.

logEnergyMonitoring.title: Log Energy Monitoring Events
logEnergyMonitoring.description: Enable logging of power/energy monitoring characteristic updates (Volts, Amperes, Watts, KiloWattHours).

hideHomeKitMatter.title: Hide HomeKit or Matter Devices
hideHomeKitMatter.description: Hide HomeKit or Matter Devices from Homebridge.

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to check device status in the background (seconds)

discoveryPollingInterval.title: Discovery Polling Interval (seconds)
discoveryPollingInterval.description: How often to discover new devices in the background (seconds)

offlineInterval.title: Offline Interval (days)
offlineInterval.description: How often to remove offline devices in the background (days)

additionalBroadcasts.title: Additional Broadcast Addresses
additionalBroadcasts.description: List of additional broadcast addresses to discover devices on. Format: 192.168.1.255

manualDevices.title: Manual List Of Devices
manualDevices.description: List of devices to manually add.

excludeMacAddresses.title: Exclude MAC Addresses
excludeMacAddresses.description: List of MAC addresses to exclude from device discovery. Format: AA:BB:CC:11:22:33

includeMacAddresses.title: Include MAC Addresses
includeMacAddresses.description: List of MAC addresses to include in device discovery. Format: AA:BB:CC:11:22:33

waitTimeUpdate.title: Wait Time Update (milliseconds)
waitTimeUpdate.description: The time to wait to combine similar commands for a device before sending a command to a device (milliseconds). Default: 100.

pythonPath.title: Python Path
pythonPath.description: Full Path to the Python executable. If not set, the plugin will try to find the Python executable or default to the System Path.
pythonPath.placeholder: Enter custom Full Python Path if needed, i.e. /usr/bin/python3.11

advancedPythonLogging.title: Advanced Python Logging
advancedPythonLogging.description: Enable detailed logging for Python scripts. Only shows logs when Debug Mode in Homebridge is enabled.

layout.helpvalue: Username and Password will be required for specific devices only.

layout.title: Energy (Optional)
layout.description: Configure energy-based Outlet In Use handling and optional energy characteristics.

items.title: Additional Broadcasts
items.description: Specify additional broadcast addresses for device discovery.

items.title: Manual Devices
items.description: If automatic discovery is not working, try this.

items.helpvalue: Before resorting to manually specifying devices. Try setting the broadcast address and check your router/switch/firewall configuration. You must assign static IP addresses to your devices to use this configuration.

items.title: Exclude MAC Addresses
items.description: Specify MAC addresses to exclude from device discovery.

items.title: Include MAC Addresses
items.description: Specify MAC addresses to include in device discovery.

layout.title: Advanced Settings (Optional)
layout.description: Don't change these, unless you understand what you're doing.
